name: io.github.sightradar-hq/sightradar-mcp
title: SightRadar
description: Face recognition: index photos, find a person's photos from a selfie, batches, webhooks, billing.

environmentVariables.name: SIGHTRADAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SightRadar API key (frs_...). Create one at https://sightradar.com/dashboard/keys

environmentVariables.name: SIGHTRADAR_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to expose: read, search, write, delete, account, all. Default read,search,write,delete.

environmentVariables.name: SIGHTRADAR_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders file_path may read. Default: home directory; 'none' disables.
